title: Differences of integer multiplicity currents are integer multiplicity (Simon Ch. 6, Remark 3.2(1))
statement: Let U ⊆ ℝ^P be open and let S, T ∈ 𝒟_n(U) be integer multiplicity currents. Then S − T is integer multiplicity.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (S T : GeometricCurrentOn U n), IsOpen U → IsIntegerMultiplicity S → IsIntegerMultiplicity T → IsIntegerMultiplicity (S - T)
